control_objective: Documented policy set approved and reviewed annually
Roles and responsibilities defined and allocated

control_name: Inventory of information and other associated assets
control_objective: Complete inventory of applications, services and data
Strong authentication secrets managed and protected
Access granted, reviewed and removed on a defined cycle
Security requirements defined for every provider

control_name: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
control_objective: Security requirements written into supplier agreements

control_name: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
control_objective: Annual review of provider assurance reports

control_name: Information security for use of cloud services
control_objective: Cloud provider controls verified, not assumed

control_name: Information security incident management planning and preparation
control_objective: Documented incident response plan
Incidents responded to per documented procedure
Continuity and recovery arrangements documented

control_name: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
control_objective: Applicable obligations identified and tracked
Privacy notice, lawful basis and deletion route in place
External review of the first-party assessment
Operating procedures documented and available

control_name: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
control_objective: Access and obligations handled at offboarding
Assets outside company premises protected
Endpoint encryption, updates and screen lock enforced
Administrative access restricted and reviewed
MFA enforced on all administrative and provider accounts
Spend caps and usage alerts on metered services
Dependency alerts monitored with remediation SLAs
Configurations defined, documented and monitored
Backups taken and restore-tested on a schedule
Application and administrative activity logged and retained
Networks and systems monitored for anomalies
Encryption in transit and at rest; secrets never in source
Secret scanning and push protection enabled

control_name: Separation of development, test and production
control_objective: Preview and production environments separated
Changes reviewed before promotion, with rollback defined
